deviations: Retained upstream UPSTREAM.txt, MIT license, and upstream rule sources; local plugins use Vite+' s bundled vite-plus/lint/plugins API instead of separately pinned oxlint.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-leadership-reach: its unit-leadership domain semantics do not exist in this project.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-git-history: this project has no depth-1 hosted journey contract.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-literal-window-instant: this project does not use mono-web's journey clock/window fixture conventions.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-raw-advisory-lock-sql: this project's architecture forbids advisory locks outright; the rule is tied to mono-web's lockAdvisory construct.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-json-text-parameter: this rule is tied to mono-web's canonicalJsonValue and Database encoding APIs.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-hand-rolled-postgres: this rule is tied to mono-web's startDisposablePostgres construct.
Dropped mono-web-specific no-port-probe: this rule is tied to mono-web's reserveLoopbackPorts harness.
